device.soc: ALi M3529A / C3505 (bootloader "M3529A 1.1.2", seecode "M3606 SEE", 256 MB DDR3)

source.note: Archive Amiko_HD8255_1.4.30_emu.abs from AMIKO HD8255+; added for expanded coverage.

simulator.note: Boots as C3505 with 256 MB DDR3 (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_hd8255_plus_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8255_plus_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, copies itself to 0x81000000, sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, writes " ON " to the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 108 (SDA), shows the boot logo through VideoOutputM36F, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (EBase 0x80002000 / 0x8E002001).  The application prints "---led 455 attach OK--" and updates the CH455 panel to " on ", completes 2,136 SEE RPC calls (including DSC Command Queue operations in crypto_engine.py), and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD dialog through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Amiko HD8255+ (System ID 6C000A00) firmware v1.3.88 EMU (2019-07-03) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the ALi M3529A / C3505 Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 CI+ satellite receiver with 256 MB DDR3.
Pairs dual-CPU C3505 maincode + seecode ("M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200) with a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 / 108 (" ON " -> " on ") and a 60-entry 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
